response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code GROUP BY z.city), shares AS (SELECT city, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM city_counts) AS share FROM city_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - o.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.share > o.avg_share
